cohort: All indoor patients with malpresentations in SMGS Hospital, Government Medical College Jammu from November 2021 to October 2022.
finding: The prevalence of malpresentations was 0.87%, with breech presentation being the most common (92.1%), and malpresentations were associated with adverse fetomaternal outcomes, including lower Apgar scores, increased NICU admissions, and neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: 70.2% of patients with malpresentations had a caesarean section, while 29.8% had a vaginal delivery, and neonates born vaginally to mothers with malpresentations had significantly lower Apgar scores at one minute compared to those born by caesarean section (p<0.001).
gest_age: Term pregnancies were in the majority (77.2%)
